verdict.rationale: Keycloak is an identity and access management server, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an official MCP server. The Admin REST API and the kcadm.sh CLI are developer building blocks that someone could wrap in an MCP server, which is not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
